findings.what: Relies on experimental node:sqlite (Node >=22.5) without declaring an engines constraint; on older Node the contact action fails at runtime.
SQLite file is written to <cwd>/data/app.db by default; on read-only or serverless deploys messages fail to save or are lost, and this is undocumented.
Length limits use String.length (UTF-16 code units), so astral characters such as emoji count double; limits are checked after trim, unlike the client maxLength.
The role=status paragraph is always rendered and styled red when not in success state (including idle); validation failures set no summary message.
